main_text.head: PARALYSEOS CVRATIO.
main_text.p: VICTVS ratione calfaciente & siccante, & ob hoc pituitæ generationē prohibente, vt aëre calido ficco per ignem lu culentum, suffitum ex caryophyllis, & aliis similibus. Caue tamen ne initio fluente scili cet materia multum calfacientibus materiā colliques, & fusam calore per vias à calore eodem latiores redditas ad fluendū magis pro noces. Vt cibis calidis siccis natura & arte, vt perdicibus, auiculis aßis, vel frixis, pane biscocto, & si vis anisato, melanthiato, sac charato. Vt cæteris denique sumendis, admo uendis, educendis, faciendis facultate quandā naturalem calfaciendi & siccandi sortitis.

2. PITVITAM coquentibus, & ad ex pulsionem incidendo, tenuando, tergendo pa rantibus, primo quidem triduo, aut quatri duo clementioribus, vt mellis rosati colati se scuncia cum duplo aquarū saluiæ & betho nicæ: deinde purgato blandius corpore, melle rosato

page.notes: Heading "PARALYSEOS CVRATIO." and the italic argument line are set in small capitals/roman. Section marker "1." appears in the left margin as a small mark beside "VICTVS"; the large initial V is joined to "ICTVS". Text is faint in places; "aßis" is likely "assis" with the long s printed as ß-like form, and "rosati" is read with some uncertainty.
